identity.name: BRUTALK
identity.one_line_description: BRUTALK is a raw, no-nonsense language learning platform that strips away the fluff and delivers real-world fluency through structured classes, expert instructors, and brutal honesty about what it takes to learn a language.
identity.target_audience: Ambitious adult learners aged 18–40 who are frustrated with slow, gamified language apps and want a serious, structured, instructor-led path to real fluency.

pages.title: Home

Anchor the visitor with a confrontational hero moment, then build trust through proof, offerings, and a final aggressive CTA that pushes them to act.
pages.meta_description: BRUTALK is the language learning platform for people who are done messing around. Real classes. Real instructors. Real fluency. No filters.

sections.intent: Neutralize the objections that stop a serious learner from enrolling — answered bluntly and without corporate softening, consistent with the brand voice.
sections.headline: Questions We Get. Answered Honestly.

items.title: Do I need any prior knowledge to start?
items.description: No. A1 classes start from absolute zero. You don't need to know a single word. But you do need to show up and participate.

items.title: What happens if I miss a class?
items.description: You'll receive a session summary and access to the instructor's notes. You will not receive a recording. Attendance matters.

items.title: How long is each class?
items.description: 90 minutes per session. Most tracks run two sessions per week. That's three hours of live instruction weekly — the minimum effective dose.

items.title: Can I switch levels mid-track?
items.description: Yes, with instructor approval after a brief spoken assessment. We don't let students self-diagnose their level — that's how people stagnate.

items.title: Are classes recorded?
items.description: No. This is a deliberate choice. Presence is the product. You learn by doing, not by watching yourself do it later.

sections.intent: A moment of deliberate stillness in a functional page — explain the philosophy behind the schedule structure so the visitor understands that session timing and frequency are not arbitrary but are built around proven acquisition science.
sections.eyebrow: Why the Schedule Is Built This Way
sections.headline: Frequency Is the Mechanism. Not Motivation.
sections.body: Language acquisition research is unambiguous: distributed practice beats marathon sessions. BRUTALK's schedule is built around two 90-minute live sessions per week — enough frequency to maintain active recall, short enough to demand full presence every time. We don't offer daily classes because daily classes produce fatigue, not fluency. We don't offer weekly classes because one session a week produces forgetting, not progress. Two sessions. Ninety minutes each. Every week. That's the dose.

sections.intent: A deliberate pause in the roster — explain the instructor vetting process with the same bluntness the brand uses everywhere else. This section builds institutional trust by showing that instructor quality is not accidental.
sections.headline: Getting On This Roster Is Not Easy.
sections.body: Every BRUTALK instructor application goes through a four-stage vetting process: a language proficiency assessment at C2 or native level, a live teaching demonstration with a panel of senior instructors, a curriculum design exercise reviewed by our academic team, and a six-week probationary cohort with student feedback scoring. We reject approximately 80% of applicants. The 20% who make it through are the ones your fluency depends on. We don't apologize for the bar being high.

sections.intent: Walk the visitor through the instructor vetting pipeline step by step — each stage should feel weighty and sequential, building confidence that the people teaching on BRUTALK have genuinely earned their place.
sections.headline: Four Stages. No Shortcuts.

items.title: Stage 1 — Proficiency Assessment
items.description: All applicants complete a standardized C2-level written and spoken proficiency test in their target language. Native speakers are not exempt.

items.title: Stage 2 — Live Teaching Demo
items.description: A 30-minute live class delivered to a panel of three senior BRUTALK instructors acting as students. Evaluated on clarity, pacing, error correction, and engagement.

items.title: Stage 3 — Curriculum Design Exercise
items.description: Applicants design a 4-week A2 lesson plan aligned to CEFR descriptors. Reviewed by our academic advisory board for rigor and originality.

items.title: Stage 4 — Probationary Cohort
items.description: Accepted applicants run one live cohort under observation. Student feedback is collected, scored, and reviewed. Instructors who pass are offered a permanent contract.

sections.intent: Handle the last-mile objections that stop a convinced visitor from pulling the trigger on payment — answered with the same brutal honesty the brand uses everywhere.
sections.headline: The Questions That Are Stopping You. Answered.

items.title: Is the first class really free?
items.description: Yes. Pick any available session, book a seat, show up. No card required. If it's not for you, we'd rather know now.

items.title: What if I need to pause my plan?
items.description: You can pause for up to 30 days once per billing cycle. More than that and you'll need to cancel and re-enroll. We don't do indefinite holds.

items.title: Can I upgrade or downgrade mid-month?
items.description: Yes. Changes take effect at the start of your next billing cycle. Prorated credits are applied automatically.

items.title: Are there discounts for students or educators?
items.description: We offer a 20% discount for verified full-time students and a 15% discount for language educators. Apply via the account settings after sign-up.

items.title: What if my instructor leaves the platform?
items.description: You'll be placed in a new cohort with a comparable instructor within 48 hours. No sessions missed, no credit lost.
